name: utm-check
title: UTM Check
description: UTM link checker that catches mixed case and spaces, source and medium swapped, a medium GA4's default channel rules file as organic or Unassigned, misspelled keys, a second "?", tags after "#" and tags on internal links, and reads back the GA4 channel.

meta.summary: Catches campaign links that split analytics: inconsistent casing, swapped source and medium, misspelled keys and tags that land as Unassigned.
catches: Case and spacing that split reports (Facebook vs facebook)
Values your reports already spell differently
Mediums that GA4 default channel rules send to organic or Unassigned
Misspelled UTM keys, a second ?, or tags after #
UTM tags on links to your own site
limits: Channel prediction follows GA4's default channel group; custom channel groups differ
Source lists are short built-ins; pass your own for wider coverage
a11y: URL and builder fields have <label>s; issues linked via aria-describedby
Issues and the predicted channel in a polite live region
Fix and fix-all are labelled buttons with Undo

sources.label: Google Analytics Help – [GA4] Default channel group

rules.note: Confirmed the page defines GA4 default channels (e.g. Paid Social) and that Unassigned is used when no channel rule matches. The individual rule conditions in utm.ts were not re-checked one by one.
